name: Verizon Connect
description: Verizon Connect provides GPS fleet management software through its Reveal platform, giving fleets near-real-time vehicle and asset visibility, route and vehicle history, operational reporting, driver and productivity insights, fuel and idling analysis, maintenance support, and connected tracking hardware.
best_for: Commercial fleets that want established GPS tracking, near-real-time vehicle visibility, route history, operational reporting, and connected hardware backed by Verizon Connect services.
features: Near-real-time live map for vehicles and assets
Vehicle route and activity history with breadcrumb-style replays
Vehicle status, location, heading, ignition, odometer, engine hours, fuel, and diagnostic information
Fuel and idling analytics plus cost-analysis reporting
Fleet dispatching and operational visibility for mobile workforces
Vehicle and asset trackers plus optional connected camera hardware
Customer portal for billing, contracts, support cases, and subscription management

pricing.starting_price: Contact sales / see plans and pricing

tiers.name: Reveal / GPS fleet tracking
tiers.notes: Verizon Connect directs buyers to See plans & pricing / Talk to an expert. No public numeric subscription price was found on the current official GPS fleet-tracking product pages.

pros: Established near-real-time fleet tracking with live maps and route history
Connected hardware and service support are managed within the same vendor ecosystem
Reveal combines location data with vehicle, fuel, idling, and cost-reporting context
cons: No public numeric subscription price on the current product page
Hardware service visits can carry additional fees depending on the request and contract
Exact capabilities and economics depend on the subscribed Reveal services and connected devices
